I am very disappointed with my experience at this clinic, which cost me a good month of my time. Although the staff and the attending physician were very friendly and accommodating, there were significant problems. Appointments made by phone were missed on several occasions. The initial diagnosis was immediate surgery, and I was told to wait until the end of the month for the surgeon. This recommendation was confirmed after X-rays and an MRI. It's not right to leave someone in such uncertainty for so long. Fortunately, I sought a third opinion on the mainland. After almost a month, during which my knee became increasingly stiff, it turned out that only physiotherapy was necessary. A good doctor should present all treatment options, not just the seemingly most lucrative one.
